description: Released training prompt sets of DN-MOPD. Download them with data/download.py (from the pinned Hugging Face dataset revision below) or rebuild them from public sources with data/build/build_data.py; both check every file against the sha256 listed here.

row_schema.prompt: chat messages [{role, content}] (student, math, code) or a plain string (teacher IF; the trainer wraps it as one user message)
row_schema.label: math: reference answer; code: JSON string {inputs, outputs} of test cases; IF: JSON string list of constraints
row_schema.metadata: {domain, data_source, src_index}: domain selects the verifier; src_index is the row's position in its source pool

student/train_3domain.jsonl.used_by: every student run (Label, DN-MOPD, single-teacher OPD, uniform pool, dynamic router, annealed injection, SeqKD-SFT generation, controls)
